name: VVV CL005 (Hubble)
blurb: VVV CL005, a dust-shrouded star cluster in the Milky Way, seen by Hubble.
label: vvvcl005-hubble
story: Hidden behind thick dust in our own galaxy, this cluster was found in the VVV survey; Hubble returned to it in an effort to unveil some of the Milky Way's most heavily obscured star clusters.

claims.text: VVV CL005 was discovered in the VVV survey, at RA 11:38:59, Dec -63:28:44
It is a target of program 17918 on extremely obscured Galactic clusters
